prompt: Mateo held five bread rolls and asked (the soup / to be) hot.
explanation_ru: В косвенном общем вопросе (да/нет) ставится союз if или whether, прямой порядок слов и сдвиг глагола be в Past Simple (was).

prompt: The scales flashed red. Jia asked ___ too heavy.
options: was her bag
if her bag was
that her bag was
if was her bag
explanation_ru: После ask в общем вопросе нужен союз if или whether и прямой порядок слов (her bag was). Союз that и обратный порядок слов (was her bag) — частые ошибки.

prompt: A boy at the museum asks why (the dinosaur / to have) one leg.
explanation_ru: После why в косвенном вопросе используется прямой порядок слов без вспомогательного does, а так как глагол asks стоит в настоящем времени, сдвиг времён не нужен.

prompt: Beatriz asked the waiter why was the soup cold again.
answer: Beatriz asked the waiter why the soup was cold again.
accepted_answers: Beatriz asked the waiter why the soup was cold again.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе после why сохраняется прямой порядок слов: сначала подлежащее (the soup), затем глагол (was). Типичная ошибка — оставлять инверсию из прямого вопроса.

prompt: Holding a broken pot at a dig in Jordan, a volunteer asked the leader ___.
options: was it really two thousand years old
that it was really two thousand years old
whether it was really two thousand years old
if was it really two thousand years old
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос в косвенной речи вводится союзом whether или if с прямым порядком слов (it was). Нельзя опускать союз, заменять его на that или ставить глагол перед подлежащим.

prompt: A woman stopped a taxi in Cape Town. She asked the driver (his boot / can / to hold) her folded pram.
explanation_ru: В общем косвенном вопросе добавляется if или whether, сохраняется прямой порядок слов, а модальный глагол can в прошедшем контексте сдвигается в could.

prompt: “Are the diving boards open for the school event?” a parent asked the lifeguard. → A parent asked the lifeguard …
answer: A parent asked the lifeguard if the diving boards were open for the school event.
accepted_answers: A parent asked the lifeguard if the diving boards were open for the school event.
A parent asked the lifeguard whether the diving boards were open for the school event.
explanation_ru: При переводе общего вопроса в косвенную речь добавляется if или whether, порядок слов становится прямым, are сдвигается в were, а вопросительный знак заменяется точкой.

prompt: Cold wind blew across the rocks at the bird station in Norway. A visitor tapped Ingrid on the shoulder and asked (the grey birds / to rest) or looking for food. She then wanted to know why (they / to seem) so calm near people. Before answering, Ingrid wondered (the visitor / can / to see) the small nest behind the stone.

blanks.answer: if the grey birds were resting
accepted_answers: if the grey birds were resting
whether the grey birds were resting

explanation_ru: Во всех трёх косвенных вопросах нужен прямой порядок слов и сдвиг времён в прошлое (were resting, seemed, could see); общие вопросы вводятся союзом if или whether.

prompt: Inside the planetarium in Santiago, a schoolgirl asked the astronomer: “Why does the moon look bigger near the ground?” Which sentence reports her question correctly?
options: The girl asked the astronomer if the moon was moving closer to the ground.
The girl asked the astronomer why did the moon look bigger near the ground.
The girl asked the astronomer why the moon looked bigger near the ground.
The girl told the astronomer why the moon looked bigger near the ground.
explanation_ru: Девочка задала специальный вопрос с why, поэтому нужен глагол asked и прямой порядок слов без did. Варианты с told и if искажают смысл исходной реплики.

prompt: Nobody asked why (we / to need) our laptops in the front row.
explanation_ru: После why в косвенном вопросе используется прямой порядок слов без did, а глагол need переходит в Past Simple (needed).

prompt: When my roommate warned me about the windowsill in Warsaw, I asked (the pigeons / to steal) food from plates.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос в косвенной речи вводится через if или whether с прямым порядком слов без did и сдвигом глагола steal в Past Simple (stole).

prompt: During the student club meeting in Cape Town, Thabo admitted spending the party money on snacks for himself. Several members immediately asked how much (he / to spend) before anyone noticed. The club president then asked (he / will / to return) the full amount by Friday. After the meeting, I wondered why (nobody / to check) the club account earlier that term.
explanation_ru: Во всех вопросах сохраняется прямой порядок слов: действия до собрания передаются в Past Perfect (had spent, had checked), а обещание на будущее после asked требует if/whether и сдвига will в would.

prompt: In the computer lab, I asked if could I drink water.
answer: In the computer lab, I asked if I could drink water.
accepted_answers: In the computer lab, I asked if I could drink water.
In the computer lab, I asked whether I could drink water.
explanation_ru: После союза if в косвенном вопросе ставится прямой порядок слов: сначала подлежащее (I), потом модальный глагол (could), а не could I.

prompt:
— Diego ran to his exam in pyjamas!
— Really? Did you ask (the teacher / to let) him inside?
explanation_ru: В косвенном общем вопросе нужен союз if или whether и прямой порядок слов. О более раннем событии обычно говорят в Past Perfect (had let), но в живой речи допустим и Past Simple (let).

prompt: Without looking up from my phone, I asked our tired editor in Cairo how many lines (I / must / to cut) before the evening deadline.
explanation_ru: После how many lines в косвенном вопросе сохраняется прямой порядок слов без did, а модальный глагол must в значении обязанности в прошлом переходит в had to.

prompt: The coffee machine was broken. Liam asked ___ only hot water.
options: why did it make
why made it
why does it make
why it made
explanation_ru: В косвенном специальном вопросе после why нужен прямой порядок слов без did/does и сдвиг времени в Past Simple (it made).

prompt: Ten minutes before the meeting in Mumbai, our supervisor admitted he had forgotten to book the room. Priya immediately asked where (all of us / will / to sit). Another colleague wondered why (our boss / not / to want) to move the talk to Monday. In the hallway, I whispered to Priya and asked (she / to know) the Wi-Fi code for the café downstairs.

blanks.cue: all of us / will / to sit

explanation_ru: Во всех косвенных вопросах используется прямой порядок слов и сдвиг времён: will переходит в would, отрицание в Past Simple строится как did not want, а общий вопрос требует if или whether.

prompt: “Could you tell me where (taxis / to park) at night?” a new driver asked.
explanation_ru: В вежливом вопросе после Could you tell me используется прямой порядок слов без вспомогательного do, и время остаётся в Present Simple (taxis park).

prompt: Sofía printed a poster backwards in Mexico City, yet the client ordered twenty more and never asked how (the error / to happen).
explanation_ru: После how в косвенном вопросе ставится прямой порядок слов без did; так как ошибка произошла до заказа, используется Past Perfect (had happened), но допустим и Past Simple (happened).

prompt: Once the recruiter at the Brussels job fair admitted losing half the forms on the train, Claire emailed to ask ___.
options: whether her form had been lost
had her form been lost too
that her form had been lost
whether had her form been lost
explanation_ru: В косвенном общем вопросе после ask нужен союз whether или if и прямой порядок слов (her form had been lost). Инверсия и союз that здесь ошибочны.

prompt: Staff at the call centre asked how long (each break / to last).
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе после how long сохраняется прямой порядок слов без did, а глагол last переходит в Past Simple (lasted).

prompt: During hotel training in Bangkok, Suda told us how she had called one guest by the wrong name for a whole week. A young trainee immediately asked why (the man / never / to correct) her. Someone else wondered (the guest / to notice) the mistake at check-in. Suda smiled and asked (anyone / to make) a funny mistake like that before.
explanation_ru: Во всех вопросах сохраняется прямой порядок слов без did, а события до момента разговора передаются в Past Perfect (в первых двух случаях допустим и Past Simple); общие вопросы вводятся через if/whether.

prompt: Standing outside the bookshop in Edinburgh, the delivery man asked me whether the back door was unlocked.
answer: Standing outside the bookshop in Edinburgh, the delivery man asked me whether the back door was unlocked.
accepted_answers: Standing outside the bookshop in Edinburgh, the delivery man asked me whether the back door was unlocked.
explanation_ru: В этом предложении ошибки нет: после asked стоит союз whether, прямой порядок слов (the back door was) и верный сдвиг времени в Past Simple.

prompt: A mother looked at white shoes in a Madrid shop. The shop worker said white shoes got dirty in one day. The mother asked (the shop / to sell) the same shoes in blue. Then her son asked how much (the blue pair / to cost).
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос вводится союзом if/whether с прямым порядком слов (sold), а в вопросе после how much также не нужен did, причём форма Past Simple у глагола cost совпадает с начальной.

prompt: I lost my phone receipt in Helsinki. At the shop, I asked the manager (they / to keep) a copy.
explanation_ru: Для передачи общего вопроса о правиле магазина нужен союз if или whether, прямой порядок слов и сдвиг глагола keep в Past Simple (kept).

prompt: At the chemist in Prague, I asked, “Could you tell me (a photo on my phone / to work) as ID?”

blanks.cue: a photo on my phone / to work
blanks.answer: if a photo on my phone works
accepted_answers: if a photo on my phone works
whether a photo on my phone works

explanation_ru: В вежливом вопросе после Could you tell me нужен союз if или whether и прямой порядок слов без вспомогательного does (works).

prompt: Last week I took a hundred roses to the wrong wedding in Quito, and the bride still thanked me. Back at the flower shop, Rosa asked how (I / to reach) the wrong church. She also asked (the other bride / to receive) her flowers yet. Finally, she wondered why (nobody / to call) the shop about the missing roses.

blanks.answer: if the other bride had received
accepted_answers: if the other bride had received
whether the other bride had received

explanation_ru: Во всех вопросах нужен прямой порядок слов без did; действия, произошедшие до разговора (особенно с маркером yet), передаются в Past Perfect, а общий вопрос вводится союзом if/whether.

prompt: The hotel in Nice had promised a sea view. Kamil went to reception to ask ___.
options: why did his room face the car park
why his room faced the car park
why was his room facing the car park
why does his room face the car park
explanation_ru: После why в косвенном вопросе ставится прямой порядок слов без did/does и без инверсии was his room, а глагол сдвигается в Past Simple (faced).

prompt: Even though Lucas had never climbed above five metres in Lyon, he still asked the instructor how high was the yellow wall.
answer: Even though Lucas had never climbed above five metres in Lyon, he still asked the instructor how high the yellow wall was.
accepted_answers: Even though Lucas had never climbed above five metres in Lyon, he still asked the instructor how high the yellow wall was.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе после how high требуется прямой порядок слов: подлежащее (the yellow wall) должно стоять перед глаголом (was).

prompt: Although the projector stopped three times during the first half in Krakow, the cinema worker asked (we / to enjoy) the ending and why (everyone / to stay) until the credits.
explanation_ru: Первый косвенный вопрос — общий (нужны if/whether и прямой порядок слов), второй — специальный (после why нет did); о событиях во время сеанса обычно говорят в Past Perfect, но допустим и Past Simple.

prompt: After spending a sleepless night beside the noisy shower block at a Swedish campsite, Astrid sent a polite email to the site manager. She explained that her children had woken up twice and asked (a quieter corner / to remain) free near the lake. She also wondered what time (the showers / to close) at night so she could plan around the noise. Within an hour, the manager replied with a map and asked which spot by the trees (her family / to prefer). Finally, he offered extra blankets for the cool evening air.
explanation_ru: В общем вопросе ставится if или whether, а в специальных вопросах после what time и which spot сохраняется прямой порядок слов без did с сдвигом глаголов в Past Simple.

prompt: Before driving his lorry off the ferry between Italy and Greece, Nikos stopped and asked a crew member: “Did anyone find a black phone on the upper deck?” Which sentence reports his question accurately?
options: Nikos asked a crew member had anyone found a black phone on the upper deck.
Nikos asked a crew member if anyone had found a black phone on the upper deck.
Nikos asked a crew member where someone had left a black phone on the upper deck.
Nikos told a crew member that he had found a black phone on the upper deck.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос в Past Simple (Did anyone find…?) передаётся через if/whether, прямой порядок слов и Past Perfect (had found). Остальные варианты либо нарушают порядок слов, либо меняют смысл.
